description: One link that opens several promotions together on one page of dealio.be (dealio.be/lijst/…), in the order given, with an optional title: for the promotions you propose to the user after one or more searches, so they need not open them one by one. Use the ids from search_deals, get_deal or get_meal_ideas (2 to 30). Unknown ids are reported and left out.

ids.description: The promotion ids, in the order to show them.

title.description: A short title for the page, e.g. 'Coca-Cola per liter' or 'Boodschappen voor zaterdag'. Optional.

name: list_link
